verdict.rationale: Metronome is a billing platform whose automations (auto-recharge, threshold actions, invoice syncing) could plausibly be versioned, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way to version, review, or roll back automations. Polling a history of seat edits and archiving billable metrics are adjacent features, not automation versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
